title: Write request
description: `{ items }`, at most 200, run in order; or `{ import }`, an export file written as if its items were sent.

items.description: The items to write, run in order (1 to 200); each has a `type`.

into.description: `new`: the path's board is made for it, titled from the file, and must not exist yet. `current`: added to the path's board, every container a new one, beside what it holds.

file.description: An export file (`get_board` with `export`) of any version: upgraded first, then what this board can't take is dropped and named in `dropped`, then its items are written as if sent here, with new card numbers.

import.description: Write an export file in place of `items`.
import.$comment: Was: D-107, api.md 198. `file` is any object here: an older version or an unknown field must reach the upgrade and the conditioning, which name what they drop; export-file.schema.json checks the result.

itemsOrImport.description: A write carries `items` or `import`, one of them.
itemsOrImport.$comment: Kept in `$defs` and referenced by `$id`, so the `not` below is reported with the words beside it (server/schema.ts `removedWords`).

then.description: an import's items are in its `file`: send `items` or `import`, not both
